title: Attack on Titan no Requiem Released Fan Project Question Bank
adaptationBoundary: Fan-created alternate continuity only: the released AoT no Requiem doujinshi Parts 1–4 and the project's official supplementary pages. It is not official Attack on Titan canon.
notes: Every narrative question is tied to an official reader image or the official supplementary text; Part 2 and Part 3 reader metadata questions are explicitly about the released reader assets, not inferred plot details.
Status is verified against the official project pages and their accessible English reader assets.
The project homepage states that this is a fan-made alternate ending and replaces original manga releases 137–139; those claims define the bank's continuity boundary.

questions.prompt: What kind of work does the project homepage call Attack on Titan: Requiem?
questions.explanation: The homepage explicitly describes it as a fan-made alternate ending.

questions.prompt: Which original manga releases does the homepage say the project replaces?

questions.prompt: Which source chapters does the homepage say precede the divergent scenario?

questions.prompt: How does the homepage characterize the project’s contributors?
